From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@alephhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Dec 2027 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo — evaluation next steps

Hi Sam — great to meet today. Thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc, that helps a lot. Below is a concise recap and the concrete artifacts we can share immediately to get the pilot started.

Quick recap / recommended slate
- Quality-first (single-model): Llama-2-13B-Chat-Q4 (float16 baseline; Q4 quantized candidate). Redwood-verified profile: 120 TPS steady, p99 latency 180ms @ gpu-type:A100-80GB (pilot-size).
- Cost/latency-balanced: RedXL-7B-q8 (optimized for inference; Q8). Redwood-verified profile: 300 TPS steady, p99 latency 95ms @ gpu-type:A100-80GB.
- Fallback / low-cost: RedLite-3B-int8 (good for short prompts and simple extraction). Redwood-verified profile: 650 TPS steady, p99 latency 45ms @ gpu-type:A100-80GB.

Notes on quantization & regression risk
- Q4 (Llama-2-13B-Chat-Q4) tends to preserve instruction-following for extraction tasks but shows small precision drops on edge-case entities; we recommend a small eval set (2000 labeled examples) to quantify delta pre/post quantization.
- Q8 (RedXL-7B-q8) is usually safe for extraction and gives large throughput gains; rare tokenization edge cases can be caught with a targeted prompt fuzzing step.
- We will flag any >2% F1 drop as a regression and suggest falling back to float16 for those request classes.

Artifacts shared (links + attachments)
- Redwood benchmark folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-benchmarks-Aleph-2027
- Verified perf profiles: https://app.redwood.com/profiles/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 (and UI for other models)
- Prompt set used in demo (attached): prompt_set_v1.txt
- Summary CSV with test harness outputs (attached): redwood_benchmarks_summary.csv

Pilot suggestion (2-week technical validation)
1) Week 0: exchange access + shared prompt set, run Redwood-hosted baseline on your sample corpus (we run & share traces).
2) Week 1: run quantized variants (q8/q4) with the 2k burst profile and a 300 qps steady run, collect accuracy/latency traces.
3) Week 2: narrow to a chosen model; run canary in prod-like routing + monitor quality/regression alerts.

Next steps / asks
- Can you share the 2k sample prompts or a representative ingestion snapshot? (Sam / Aleph platform)
- Confirm who from your infra/procurement team should be on the pilot kickoff (for DocuSign/PO).

I'll loop in Ops to reserve a pilot slot and will upload full trace links to the Drive folder above.

— Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_benchmarks_summary.csv (text/csv), prompt_set_v1.txt (text/plain)
